fields.headline: Adds $225,000 for 2024-25 to a City of Oakland summer internship stipend grant, raising it to $675,000
fields.summary: This amendment to a grant agreement with the City of Oakland, funded by the Oakland Fund for Children and Youth, pays stipends for students in summer internships in the Linked Learning program Exploring College, Career, and Community Options (ECCCO). The attached amendment sets the grant at up to $225,000 for each of 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25. The first two years were already approved (the original grant and the April 2024 First Amendment, 24-0845), so this vote adds the 2024-25 year: $225,000, raising the grant from $450,000 to $675,000.

25-0567.note: Corrected: an earlier correction counted this as adding $450,000, but the 2023-24 year had already been added by the First Amendment (24-0845). This vote adds $225,000 for 2024-25.
25-0567.sourceIssue: The text gives $225,000 without saying it is added to a $450,000 grant, and calls this "Amendment No. 1" although a First Amendment (24-0845) was approved in April 2024.
